test_title: PYST 21: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Four sentences are given, out of which three have all correct spellings. Choose the sentence with the incorrect spelt word/ words.

options.text: His hat was laying on the floor-an old black slouch with the top caved in, like a lid.
His hair was long and tangled and gressy, and hung down, and you could see his eyes shinning.
His face was repulsive in the quickening light.
Rosemary dozed for three hours and then lay awake, suspended in the moonshine.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"gressy"** seems to be a misspelling. The correct spelling is **"greasy"**, which means **covered with or resembling an oily substance**. (चिकना) • **Example: **The mechanic's hands were **greasy** from working on the car engine. • The word **"shinning"** is also misspelled. The correct spelling is **"shining"**, which means giving out or reflecting bright light. (चमकता हुआ) • **Example: **The sun was** shining** brightly in the clear blue sky. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: **His hat was laying on the floor-an old black slouch with the top caved in, like a lid. (उसकी टोपी फर्श पर पड़ी थी - एक पुरानी काली ढीली टोपी, जिसका ऊपरी हिस्सा ढका हुआ था, जैसे एक ढक्कन।) • **Example:** The hat was an old black slouch, adding to his rugged appearance. • **Option 3: **His face was repulsive in the quickening light. (उसका चेहरा तेजी से बढ़ती रोशनी में घृणास्पद था।) • **Example: **His face looked repulsive under the stark lighting. • **Option 4: **Rosemary dozed for three hours and then lay awake, suspended in the moonshine. (रोज़मेरी तीन घंटे के लिए सो गई और फिर जागते हुए, चाँदनी में निलंबित रही।) • **Example:** Rosemary lay awake, lost in the moonshine after a brief nap. 3d:Tcb8, The correct answer is **Option 3**.
